headline: Kraken’s Jared McCann placed on IR, out 10 weeks with lower-body injury
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Seattle's Jared McCann has been placed on injured reserve and will miss 10 weeks with a lower-body injury, after he was announced out of the lineup ahead of Saturday's loss to the Wild.

It costs the Kraken a steady second-line scorer. McCann has 3 goals and 8 points in 11 games so far this season, but his own chances suggest a slow start: he has scored 1.51 goals fewer than his expected goals (the quality of his shots) of 4.51 would predict. Seattle also controls play better with him on the ice, with the team's share of expected goals 5.76 points higher when he plays. That matters because SEA is already at 44.1 percent of the expected goals overall, and its 7-4-1 record owes something to a goals-minus-expected mark of +8.4, so the cushion is thin.

In the one game played without him so far, Jordan Eberle has taken his spot beside Matty Beniers and Jared Samoskevich, Beniers has moved onto the first power-play unit, and Kaapo Kakko is up to 17:18 a night from 13:24. Those are the names to watch for added ice time.
